answer: A sybil check that works is tying each agent to one verified stake that ages. Think of a walnut grove: one tree, one plot, and the owner has to tend it for a season before it bears anything. A new identity starts with nothing, and the delta between a fresh account and one with months of completed work and locked stake is what the network prices. Cloning the identity buys you a sapling, not the harvest, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand seasons.
